breakfast.name: Peanut butter banana oats
steps: Simmer oats in milk for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring.
Slice the banana on top.
Swirl in peanut butter and cinnamon.

breakfast.name: Veggie scrambled eggs on toast
steps: Soften pepper in a pan with a little oil for 2 minutes.
Add spinach until it wilts.
Pour in beaten eggs and stir gently on low heat until just set.
Serve on toast.

breakfast.name: Greek yogurt bowl
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Top with berries, granola, nuts and honey.

breakfast.name: Overnight oats (make the night before)
steps: Stir everything except the fruit in a jar.
Fridge overnight.
Add fruit in the morning and eat cold.

breakfast.name: Egg and avocado toast
steps: Toast the bread and fry or boil the eggs.
Mash avocado with salt and lemon.
Spread, top with eggs and chili flakes.

breakfast.name: Banana egg pancakes
steps: Mash banana, whisk in eggs, oats and cinnamon.
Cook small pancakes in a lightly oiled pan, 1 to 2 minutes a side.
Serve with yogurt.

breakfast.name: Breakfast smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Drink it sitting down, not while scrolling.

lunch.name: Chickpea tuna salad wrap
steps: Roughly mash chickpeas with tuna and mayo, season.
Add chopped cucumber and tomato.
Wrap it up.

lunch.name: Black bean quesadilla
steps: Mash beans lightly and spread on a tortilla.
Add cheese and veg, top with the second tortilla.
Cook in a dry pan 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Cut and dip in salsa.

lunch.name: Lentil soup (makes 4 lunches)
steps: Soften chopped onion, carrot and garlic in oil for 5 minutes.
Add cumin, lentils, tomatoes and stock.
Simmer 20 minutes until the lentils fall apart.
Season and portion into containers.

lunch.name: Egg fried rice
steps: Stir-fry veg in a hot pan with oil for 3 minutes.
Add rice and fry until hot.
Push aside, scramble eggs in the space, then mix.
Season with soy sauce and green onion.

lunch.name: Hummus veggie plate
steps: Slice the veg.
Plate with hummus, pita and the egg or cheese.

lunch.name: Chicken and veg rice bowl
steps: Cut chicken small and cook in a pan for 6 to 8 minutes.
Add broccoli and a splash of water, then cover for 3 minutes.
Stir in 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp honey and garlic.
Serve over rice.

lunch.name: Pasta salad jar
steps: Toss everything with oil, lemon, salt and pepper.
Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

dinner.name: Sheet-pan chicken and vegetables
steps: Heat oven to 220°C / 425°F.
Chop everything, toss with oil and spices on a tray.
Roast 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.

dinner.name: One-pot chickpea curry
ingredients: 1 can coconut milk or diced tomatoes
steps: Start the rice.
Soften onion and garlic, add curry powder for 1 minute.
Add chickpeas and coconut milk or tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in spinach and serve over rice.

dinner.name: Salmon, rice and greens
steps: Start the rice.
Pan-fry salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes, flip for 2 to 3 more.
Steam the greens.
Finish with lemon and a splash of soy sauce.

dinner.name: Turkey or beef chili (makes leftovers)
steps: Brown the meat with onion and pepper.
Add spices for 1 minute.
Add beans and tomatoes and simmer 20 minutes.
Eat with rice, or freeze portions.

dinner.name: Veggie stir-fry noodles
ingredients: Soy sauce, garlic, a little honey
steps: Cook noodles and drain.
Stir-fry veg and tofu or eggs in a hot pan.
Add noodles and sauce and toss for 1 minute.

dinner.name: Spaghetti with lentil bolognese
steps: Cook spaghetti.
Soften chopped onion and carrot for 5 minutes.
Add lentils and sauce and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve with parmesan.

dinner.name: Baked potato with beans and cheese
steps: Prick the potato and microwave 8 to 10 minutes, turning once.
Split, top with hot beans and cheese.
Eat with something green.

dinner.name: Shakshuka
steps: Soften onion and pepper, add spices.
Pour in tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes.
Make wells and crack in the eggs, then cover for 5 to 7 minutes.
Mop up with bread.

dinner.name: Post-gym chicken wrap
ingredients: Greek yogurt with garlic and lemon
steps: Mix yogurt, garlic, lemon and salt.
Fill the tortilla with chicken, veg and sauce.
Roll and eat. Protein after the gym helps recovery.
